title: Factorisation
summary: Taking out common factors and factorising quadratics: multiplication in reverse.

cbse.chapter: Ganita Prakash Ch 6: We Distribute, Yet Things Multiply

objectives: I can factorise by taking out common factors.
I can factorise x² + bx + c and a² − b².
I can check a factorisation by expanding.
misconceptions: Every expression can be factorised with whole numbers.
